ties_disclosure.reason: The native p-substrate (VSS) tie class is deliberately not declared and was NOT checked: sky130's p-type substrate is a native substrate with no drawn pwell/tub layer in this stream, so there is no well geometry to name for erc.missing_tie (klayout-tools#2186's documented remaining limitation). Only the nwell -> VDD class is graded; see erc-supply-spec.md.
